Augmentations (also known as augments) are items that provide benefits to your ship. They can be bought at stores or rewarded from events. Your ship can have only up to three augmentations, and the cargo storage cannot hold any of them.

Their benefits range from improving stats ([[#FTL Recharge Booster|FTL Recharge Booster]], [[Augmentations#Automated Re-loader|Automated Re-loader]]) to granting entirely new abilities ([[#Adv. FTL Navigation|Adv. FTL Navigation]]) and effects ([[#Reverse Ion Field|Reverse Ion Field]]).

Most stat-boosting Augmentations stack with each other. Augments that don't stack will be greyed out in stores if you already own one. Also, once your ship's augmentation slots are filled, any store augmentations will be greyed out too: you will need to sell at least one of the owned augments in order to be able to purchase a new one. If you loot an augment that you already own and it does not stack, you will receive 25 scrap instead (regardless of the augment's value). In other cases, if you loot an augment and don't have room for it, you must choose one augment to leave behind without receiving any scrap value, and this augment will be permanently lost after the FTL jump. It is impossible to remove installed augmentations other than to sell or swap.

Notes:<div style="margin-top:-20px;>
* Augmentations that can be stacked will have a corresponding note.
* The game does not have specific groups or categories for augmentations. Grouping of augmentations on this page is based on their utility and is purely for convenience.</div>

==Offensive Augmentations==
===Automated Re-loader===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Cooldown between weapon shots is improved by 10 percent."''</div>
* Purchase price: 40 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 2)
* Stacks additively with multiple reloaders, and stacks multiplicatively with crew skill.
* The augment description is somewhat misleading. It actually increases ''firing rate'' by 10%. You could think of it as increasing shots per minute. Reloaders stack additively, so three of them increase firing rate by 30%. Cooldown is the inverse of firing rate, so one Automated Reloader divides cooldown by 1.1.
** If "C" is the crew skill multiplier and "R" is the number of reloaders, the charge time multiplier is: <math display="inline">\text{C} \div \left({1 + \cfrac{\text{R}}{10}}\right)</math>.
** For example, with fully-trained crew and three reloaders, the multiplier is <math display="inline">{0.8} \div \left({1 + \cfrac{3}{10}}\right) = 0.615</math>, meaning a Flak 1 would fire in 6.15 seconds. ([[:Module:WeaponLoadTime|Weapon charge calculator]])
* Provides boost even if the Weapon Control system is damaged, hacked, or ionized.
* The boost is also applied to artillery systems of [[the Federation Cruiser]]s.

===Defense Scrambler===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Prevents enemy defense drones from targeting anything."''</div>
* Purchase price: 80 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 4) (Advanced Edition Content)
* Prevents enemy [[Drone_Control#Defensive_Drones|defensive drones]] from acquiring and shooting down targets.
* Affects only Defense Drone I and II and Anti-Combat Drone.
* Starting augmentation for [[Tetragon|{{tooltip|Engi C|Engi Cruiser, Layout C (Tetragon)}}]].

===Explosive Replicator===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Missile based weapons have a 50 percent chance of not using a missile."''</div>
* Purchase price: 60 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 3) (Advanced Edition Content)
* Multi-shot weapons - Swarm Missiles and Pegasus Missiles - use only one missile resource per volley and have the same 50 percent chance of not using it in their volley.

===Hacking Stun===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"All crew inside a room during a Hacking Pulse will be stunned for the duration."''</div>
* Purchase price: 60 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 3) (Advanced Edition Content)
* Affects both the enemy's and the player's crewmembers and drones.
* Any crew or drone that enter the room during the hacking pulse will also be stunned.

===Stealth Weapons===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Prevents your weapon fire from disrupting your cloak, allowing you to shoot at will while cloaked."''</div>
* Purchase price: 50 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 3)
* Removes the cloak-shortening effect caused by firing non-beam weapons while cloaked.

===Weapon Pre-Igniter===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Weapons are made immediately available after an FTL jump."''</div>
* Purchase price: 120 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 4)
* Only works for weapons that were powered from the previous beacon.
* Only skips the first charge cycle of chain weapons (so no "instant [[Laser (Weapons)#Chain Vulcan|Vulcan]]").
* Only gives one charge to charge weapons, by default. Can fully charge them using a trick <ref name="Weapon Pre-Igniter charge trick">Before making an FTL Jump: fully charge the weapon, pause the game, then depower the weapon and make the Jump. After the Jump: pause the game before the combat start (i.e. during the event intro), power up the charger weapon, let the weapon complete its current, final shot charge (it requires only few frames/moments). Now the weapon is capable of firing the maximum amount of shots at the start of a fight. (see [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cMVlkQhF3Kw video])</ref>.
* Does not affect artillery systems of [[the Federation Cruiser]]s.
* Allows multiple depowered weapons to be almost fully charged at the start of a fight. <ref name="Weapon Pre-Igniter depowered trick">Before making an FTL Jump: fully charge the weapons which you would like to shoot first at the start of the combat, pause the game; depower these weapons, and power the weapons which you would like to use after firing the initial weapons, make the Jump. After the Jump: pause the game before the combat start (i.e. during the event intro), depower the weapons which are fully charged and power the initial set of weapons, which will require only a tiny bit of time to fully charge again (only few frames/moments); shoot the "initial volley" weapons and once all shots are fired (e.g. from a burst laser), quickly swap to the other set of weapons (the pause buttons help keep the interval as short as possible). (see [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cMVlkQhF3Kw video])</ref>

===Zoltan Shield Bypass===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Allows crew/bomb teleportation and mind control to work through [[Zoltan Shield]]s."''</div>
* Purchase price: 55 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 3) (Advanced Edition Content)
* Hacking drones still cannot be launched and will be destroyed if it comes into contact with a Zoltan Shield (e.g. when the hacking drone was launched prior to a Shield Overcharger drone creating a Zoltan Shield layer).
* Boarding drones can be launched but will be destroyed upon contact with a Zoltan Shield. (the enemy doesn't launch drones against Zoltan Shield)

==Defensive Augmentations==
===Fire Suppression===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Automatically put out fires throughout the ship."''</div>
* Purchase price: 65 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 3) (Advanced Edition Content)
* Puts out all fires at once, at the same speed as a Crystal crew (slightly slower than a Human).

===Repair Arm===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Repairs your hull every time you collect scrap, but reduces scrap collected by 15 percent."''</div>
* Purchase price: 50 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 3)
* Repairs your hull for 2 points every time you collect scrap.
* The final scrap reward value with a decimal number is rounded down (against you).
* Does not reduce scrap gain if your hull is at maximum.
* The final scrap reward value will be displayed on the HUD (the preceding screen with reward shows a regular scrap amount).

===Reverse Ion Field===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Protects your ship from ion damage, giving a 50 percent chance to negate it entirely."''</div>
* Purchase price: 45 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 2)
* Stackable: immunity to all sources of ion damage, including a pulsar, with two or more.
* Ion protection is also applied to a Zoltan Shield.

===Shield Charge Booster===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Boosts the ship's shield recharge rate by 15 percent."''</div>
* Purchase price: 45 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 2)
* Stacks additively with multiple Shield Charge Boosters, and multiplicatively with crew skill.
* It's a 15% increase in recharge ''rate'', not a 15% decrease in recharge ''time''. Recharge time is the inverse of recharge rate. To find the improved time, divide by 1.15, giving about 87% of the base time (not 85%).
** If "C" is the crew skill multiplier and "B" is the number of boosters, the recharge time multiplier is: <math display="inline">1 \div \left({\text{C} * \left({1 + \cfrac{15 * \text{B}}{100}}\right)}\right)</math>.
** For example, with fully-trained crew and three boosters, the multiplier is: <math display="inline">1 \div \left({\text{1.3} * \left({1 + \cfrac{15 * \text{3}}{100}}\right)}\right)</math>.
** The resulting regeneration time of a shield layer is a product of the recharge time multiplier and the base regeneration time of a shield layer (layer 1 and 2 restore in 2 seconds each, layer 3 - in 1.72, layer 4 - in 1.5, layer 5 - in 1.33 seconds). ([[:Template:ShieldRecharge|Shield layer recharge time calculator]])
* Provides boost even if the Shields system is damaged, hacked, or ionized.

==Crew Augmentations==
===Backup DNA Bank===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Your crew is safe in clone storage even if the system is off or broken."''</div>
* Purchase price: 40 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 2) (Advanced Edition Content)
* Dead crewmembers will remain in the clone queue regardless of the state of the [[Clone Bay]], allowing you to delay their cloning for as long as necessary. Hacking pulse doesn't kill crew in the cloning queue.
* If Clone Bay is destroyed without any means to repair it (with System Repair Drone or Repair Burst), while all crew is in the cloning queue, the game will soft-lock and require a manual restart (the game over screen won't appear).
* Has no effect with a Medbay.
* Can be used in the [[Crystalline research facility]] event.

===Emergency Respirators===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Crew take half damage from low oxygen."''</div>
* Purchase price: 50 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 2) (Advanced Edition Content)
* The effect also works when boarding enemy ships, allowing safer boarding of Lanius and Automated ships.
* Allows crewmembers to heal in a level 1 Medbay without oxygen.
* [[Crew_races#Crystal|Crystal crewmembers]] take only 25% damage from low oxygen with this augment.
* Starting augmentation for all [[The Lanius Cruiser|Lanius Cruisers]] and [[The Fregatidae|{{tooltip|Federation C|Federation Cruiser, Layout C (The Fregatidae)}}]].

===Reconstructive Teleport===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Crew gets fully healed by teleportation."''</div>
* Purchase price: 70 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 3) (Advanced Edition Content)
* Will also heal mind-controlled enemies.

==FTL Augmentations==
===Adv. FTL Navigation===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Allows the ship to jump to any previously visited Beacon."''</div>
* Purchase price: 50 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 3)
* Allows jumping to previously visited beacons which were later overtaken by the Rebel Fleet.
* Can be used in the [[Civilian FTL haywire escort]] event.

===Distraction Buoys===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Leaves a false signal at sector start to delay Rebels 1 jump."''</div>
* Purchase price: 55 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 3) (Advanced Edition Content)
* Its effect works at the beginning of a sector.
* Has no effect in [[Sectors#The_Last_Stand|the final sector]].
* Can be used in the [[Crystalline ship messaging about Rebels]] event.

===FTL Jammer===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Scramble enemy ships' FTL computers, doubling the time it takes for them to jump."''</div>
* Purchase price: 30 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 3)

===FTL Recharge Booster===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"The ship's FTL Drive powers up 25 percent faster."''</div>
* Purchase price: 50 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 2)
* Stacks additively with multiple FTL Recharge Boosters.
* It's a 125% multiplier for the charge rate, not a 75% multiplier to the charge time; so charge time is multiplied by 80%. With two of them the charge time is multiplied by 67%, and with three of them - by 57%. (see [[Engines#FTL_Drive_charge_time|FTL charge time table]])

==Misc. Augmentations==
===Battery Charger===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Backup Battery's lock time is halved."''</div>
* Purchase price: 40 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 2) (Advanced Edition Content)
* Reduces the battery cooldown period from 20 down to 10 seconds.

===Drone Recovery Arm===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Non-destroyed drones will be retrieved when jumping, allowing their parts to be reused."''</div>
* Purchase price: 50 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 2)
* Only recovers your deployed external drones: combat drones - after the ship fight, defense drones - after initiating the FTL Jump.
* Does not recover Boarding Drones, Ion Intruders, or hacking drones.
* Can be used together with [[Drone_Control#Hull_Repair_Drone_2|Hull Repair Drone]]: the drone vanishes after repairing 3-5 hull points, so jumping after 2 repairs makes those repairs always free.

===Lifeform Scanner===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Detects the location of any life forms, even when sensors don't function."''</div>
* Purchase price: 40 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 3) (Advanced Edition Content)
* Functions exactly like the slugs' ability to sense live crew.
* Can be used in [[Blue_Options#Lifeform_Scanner|some]] events.

===Long-Ranged Scanners===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Adds additional info about nearby Beacons on the star map."''</div>
* Purchase price: 30 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 1)
* Reveal [[Environmental Hazards|environmental hazards]] and possible ship presence of adjacent beacons.
* Work proactively and retroactively: adjacent beacons left far behind will also have the information revealed after acquiring the scanners, all previously revealed information won't be shown anymore if the scanners are sold (or swapped out).
* If the scanners don't indicate a ship presence at a beacon, it may still result in a ship fight. Likewise, even if a ship is detected, there may be options to avoid a fight.
* Environment hazards, which may occur due to some event choices after arrival at the beacon, are not shown.
* Can be used in [[Blue_Options#Long-Ranged_Scanners|some events]].
* Starting augmentation for all [[The Stealth Cruiser|Stealth Cruisers]].

===Scrap Recovery Arm===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Allows the ship to collect 10 percent more scrap from any source."''</div>
* Purchase price: 50 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]] &nbsp;(Store rarity: 1)
* The final scrap reward value with a decimal number is rounded down (against you): if you received 19 scrap, you would get 1 extra scrap.
* Multiple Scrap Recovery Arms stack additively before rounding down: if you had 2 arms and received 15 scrap, you would get 3 extra scrap.
* The final scrap reward value will be displayed on the HUD, while the regular scrap reward amount is shown on a preceding pop-up screen.
* Contrary to in-game description, does not increase scrap collected from items sold in a Store.
* Can be used in the [[Large asteroid field]] event.

==Non-Purchasable Augmentations==
===Crystal Vengeance===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Every time your ship takes damage, there is a 10 percent chance to break off a shard that flies at your enemy."''</div>
* Sell price: 40 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]]
* Fires a crystal shot that does 1 damage, has a 10% chance to breach, has a 20% chance to stun for 3s (with Advanced Edition), completely ignores shields, and is affected by evasion; can be shot down by defense drones. &nbsp;<span style="color:grey">[ bugged: friendly defense drones can shoot it down, and friendly projectiles can intercept it, as it is considered a neutral projectile like asteroids ]</span>
* Starting augmentation for all [[The Crystal Cruiser|Crystal Cruisers]].
* Can be acquired by any ship through the Crystal Cruiser unlock event regardless if the Crystal Cruiser has already been unlocked.

===Damaged Stasis Pod===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"This bizarre alien artifact appears to be barely operational. It has no practical function but perhaps someone can repair it."''</div>
* Sell price: 15 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]]
* This "augment" is used to acquire a Crystal crewmember (named Ruwen) and, successively, to [[Ancient device|access]] the Hidden Crystal Worlds in a special event [[Ancestry|sequence]].
* Can only be acquired in the [[Dense asteroid field distress call]] event. More than one Stasis Pod can be acquired and held at a time (each one will occupy an augmentation slot).
* Can only be used during the [[Zoltan research facility]] event. Zoltan research facility can be encountered multiple times per Engi sector and once per Zoltan sector, and each one will open a single pod.

===Drone Reactor Booster===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Your shipboard drones have their movement speed increased by 25 percent."''</div>
* Sell price: 25 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]]
* Increases the speed of crew drones by 25%, however, the actual crew drone speed is increased from 50% of regular crew speed to 62.5%.
* Starting augmentation for [[The_Engi_Cruiser#Layout_B|{{tooltip|Engi B|Engi Cruiser, Layout B (The Vortex)}}]].
* Can be acquired by any ship in the [[The Engi virus|Engi Virus]] event.

===Engi Med-bot Dispersal===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Engi nano med-bots heal the crew outside of the med-bay (at a reduced speed)."''</div>
* Sell price: 30 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]]
* Heals 1.6 health points per second.
* Medbay must be powered for it to work.
* Not affected by Medbay upgrades.
* Does not work on crew that is on another ship (teleported).
* Does nothing if you have a Clone Bay.
* Can be used in [[Blue_Options#Engi_Med-bot_Dispersal|some]] events.
* Starting augmentation for [[The_Engi_Cruiser#Layout_A|{{tooltip|Engi A|Engi Cruiser, Layout A (The Torus)}}]].
* Can be acquired by any ship in the [[Rebel attacking Engi]] event.

===Mantis Pheromones===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Your crew's movement speed is increased by 25 percent."''</div>
* Sell price: 25 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]]
* Applies both on your ship and when boarding an enemy.
* Starting augmentation for all [[The Mantis Cruiser|Mantis Cruisers]].
* Can be acquired by any ship through the [[Legendary thief KazaaakplethKilik|Mantis Cruiser unlock event]], even if the Mantis Cruiser has already been unlocked.

===Rock Plating===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Superior hull armor provides a 15 percent chance to negate incoming hull damage (hit systems will still be damaged)."''</div>
* Sell price: 40 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]]
* Allows a guaranteed retrieval of a [[#Damaged Stasis Pod|Damaged Stasis Pod]] in the [[Dense asteroid field distress call]] event (without it the chances are only 1/3).
* Can be used in [[Blue_Options#Rock_Plating|some]] events.
* Doesn't protect from solar flares, fire and sabotage damage.
* Doesn't protect from damage sources with 100% breach chance -- i.e. ASBs.
* Doesn't protect from event-scripted hull damage.
* Starting augmentation for all [[The Rock Cruiser|Rock Cruisers]].
* Can be acquired by any ship through the [[Rock war vessel encounter|Rock Cruiser unlock event]], even if the Rock Cruiser has already been unlocked.

===Slug Repair Gel===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"Slug ships excrete a thick gel that automatically repairs any hull breaches."''</div>
* Sell price: 30 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]]
* Fixes all breaches simultaneously, at 75% regular crew speed.
* Stacks with crew repairs.
* Starting augmentation for all [[The Slug Cruiser|Slug Cruisers]].
* Can be acquired by any ship through the [[Slug Home Nebula surrender|Slug Cruiser unlock event]], even if the Slug Cruiser has already been unlocked.

===Titanium System Casing===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"All ship systems have additional plating that provides a 15 percent chance to negate damage when hit (hull will still be damaged)."''</div>
* Sell price: 40 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]]
* Doesn't protect from solar flares, fire and sabotage damage.
* Doesn't protect from event-scripted system damage.
<!-- @todo: does it protect systems from damage sources with 100% breach chance -- i.e. ASBs?-->
* Starting augmentation for [[The_Stealth_Cruiser#Layout_A|{{tooltip|Stealth A|Stealth Cruiser, Layout A (The Nesasio)}}]].
* Can be acquired by any ship through the [[Engi fleet discussion|Stealth Cruiser unlock event]], even if the Stealth Cruiser has already been unlocked.

===Zoltan Shield===
<div style="margin-left: 22px; margin-bottom: -5px;">''"An unexplained technology creates this nearly impenetrable shield. Only the energy outburst from an FTL engine is powerful enough to recharge it."''</div>
* Sell price: 40 [[File:Ftlgame-scrap.png]]
* Upon arrival at a beacon, you start with an additional green energy shield that will absorb 5 points of damage before your standard shields and hull will start to take damage.
* Absorbs damage from all weapon types, including missiles, bombs and beams, but takes twice as much damage from ion weapons. Beam weapons deal their room damage twice to the shield (including the [[Artillery Beam]]).
* Aiming the Hull Beam at systemless rooms will not increase damage on a Zoltan Shield.
* Until they are destroyed, Zoltan Shields prevent boarding, hacking, and mind control.
* [[Augmentations#Zoltan_Shield_Bypass|Zoltan Shield Bypass]] augmentation (available only for player ships) will allow boarding, bomb teleportation, and mind control.
* Does not prevent boarding events.
* Leaving and returning to an area with an enemy ship that has a Zoltan Shield will cause the enemy's Zoltan Shield to replenish.
* [[Environmental_Hazards#Pulsar|Pulsar]] waves cannot penetrate the Zoltan Shield, but will quickly strip it.
* Starting augmentation for all [[The Zoltan Cruiser|Zoltan Cruisers]].
* Can be acquired by any ship through the [[Unarmed_Zoltan_transport|Zoltan Cruiser unlock event]], even if the Zoltan Cruiser has already been unlocked.
* [[The Rebel Flagship]] uses a more powerful version of a Zoltan Shield (12 hit points) in phase 3.
* ''For more information, see the main article:'' [[Zoltan Shield]].
